'''Choku''' were [[Reptavian/Legends|Reptavians]] native to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. These quadrupeds are known for their bright fur.<ref name="SoR" /> The males were brown and white and the females were black and white.<ref name="SWG" /> Living and hunting in packs,<ref name="SoR" /> they were powerfully muscled carnivores and deadly hunters.<ref name="SWG:C" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ChokuFemale.jpg|thumb|left|170px|A Choku female]]
Choku appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
